name: Dust Devil

actions.name: Blinding Grit
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be blinded until end of their next turn.

actions.name: Dust Vortex
actions.effect: All creatures in a 3m radius are hit. Targets must pass PHYS save or be pushed 3m away from the Dust Devil.

reactions.name: Scatter
reactions.effect: When hit by a melee attack, the Dust Devil disperses into a cloud and reforms up to 6m away. The attacker is blinded until end of their turn.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: Can squeeze through spaces as narrow as 2cm without penalty.

traits.name: Sand Camouflage
traits.desc: In sandy or dusty environments, the Dust Devil is invisible when motionless.

lore: Dust Devils are minor elementals born where the planes of air and earth overlap. They manifest as small, swirling columns of sand and grit, driven by a mindless urge to scour everything in their path.
